Name: Hanes
ModernLocation: Disputed; proposed identifications include Heracleopolis Magna (Ihnasiyyah al Madinah) and Tahpanhes (Tell Defenneh)
Description: An Egyptian city named in Isaiah's oracle against trusting Egypt: Judah's princes were at Zoan and her ambassadors had come to Hanes, yet Egypt's help would prove worthless.
BiblicalSignificance: Hanes stands in Isaiah's warning that Egypt, however impressive, could not save Judah; trust placed there would end in shame.
